name: one hash per global query
source:
scope=globals()
calls=[]
class Key:
 def __hash__(self):calls.append('hash');return 42
 def __eq__(self,other):return self is other
k=Key()
scope[k]=7
print(calls)
calls.clear()
print(scope[k],calls)
calls.clear()
print(scope.pop(k),calls)

class Box:value=1
box=Box()
box.value=2
view=box.__dict__
class Key:
 def __hash__(self):return hash('value')
 def __eq__(self,other):return other=='value'
k=Key()
view[k]=3
print(box.value,view['value'])
print(view.pop(k))
print('value' in view,box.value)
